leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement try-catch blocks to handle synchronous errors in Node.js functions
Construct error objects with custom messages and properties for specific scenarios
Apply error-first callback patterns in asynchronous operations
Configure global error handlers to catch unhandled exceptions in Node.js applications
Integrate error handling middleware in Express.js route handlers
Manipulate error propagation in promise chains using .catch() methods
Initialize custom error classes by extending the built-in Error object
